title: Aura Effects
description: A lot of cool aura particle effects to make you look cool!
body:
A bunch of cool effects that you can get by naming debug sticks different names!

<details>
  <summary>All Effects</summary>
  
Rename a `Debug Stick` to the **`Effect Name`** of the effect you want in an **Anvil** and hold that stick (which we will call a "wand") to "equip" the effect.
| **`Effect Name`**          | **`Description`** |
| -------------------------- | ----------------- |
| Circle \| Default          | A circle around you. |
| Circle \| Swiggly          | CIRCLE DEFAULT but in an interesting shape. |
| Circle \| Aura             | CIRCLE DEFAULT that is changing color from red and black. | Circle \| Swiggly Aura     | CIRCLE AURA and CIRCLE SWIGGLY combined. |
| Vortex \| Default          | Multiple rings of circles around you.                                                                                              |
| Vortex \| Swiggly          | VORTEX DEFAULT but each ring is in an interesting shape.                                                                           |
| Vortex \| Aura             | VORTEX DEFAULT that is changing color from red and black.                                                                          |
| Vortex \| Swiggly Aura     | VORTEX AURA and VORTEX SWIGGLY combined.                                                                                             |
| Vortex \| Menace           | Multiple rings of particles that are in interesting shapes and sizes that span x, y, AND z instead of only one plane of dimension. |
| Vortex \| Menace Aura      | VORTEX MENACE that is changing color from red and black.                                                                           |
| Vortex \| Electric         | VORTEX DEFAULT but using the lightning rod sparks particles.                                                                       |
| Vortex \| Electric Menace  | VORTEX ELECTRIC and VORTEX MENACE combined.                                                                                          |
| Vortex \| Electric Swiggly | VORTEX ELECTRIC and VOTEX SWIGGLY combined.                                                                                          |
| Laser Vision               | Sets blocks on fire OR damages mobs. (depends on hit)                                                                              |
</details>
